title: Faithfulness in Marriage
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Faithfulness in marriage means covenant loyalty, sexual purity, truthfulness, patience, and persevering love between husband and wife. Marriage faithfulness reflects God’s concern for covenant promises and holy love.
summary: Faithfulness in marriage means covenant loyalty, sexual purity, truthfulness, patience, and persevering love between husband and wife. Marriage faithfulness reflects God’s concern for covenant promises and holy love.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is faithful to His people. His steadfast covenant love teaches husbands and wives that faithfulness is not merely avoiding adultery, but living in loyal, sacrificial, truthful love.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Marriage faithfulness is precious to God because marriage is covenantal. The Lord witnesses the promises made between husband and wife and cares about how those promises are kept.

Faithfulness includes sexual purity, but it is not limited to that. It includes truthfulness, emotional loyalty, tenderness, endurance, repentance, and protecting the marriage from what corrodes trust.

Scripture warns against adultery and betrayal because unfaithfulness damages souls, families, trust, worship, and witness. God’s commands are not meant to rob joy, but to protect covenant love.

Faithfulness in marriage must be joined with humility. Every marriage needs ongoing repentance, forgiveness, wise boundaries, and dependence on Christ’s grace.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A culture of convenience makes covenant faithfulness feel optional. Scripture teaches that marriage vows matter even when emotions are tested, life is hard, or selfish desire rises.

This doctrine also helps wounded spouses understand that God sees betrayal and does not treat covenant-breaking lightly. He calls His people to faithfulness, truth, and wise care.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Guard your heart, body, words, habits, and private life for the sake of covenant faithfulness. If you are married, pursue loyalty in hidden places as well as visible ones. If sin has damaged trust, seek repentance, truth, help, and restoration where wisdom allows.
